SELECT l.sample_no AS sampleNo, l.batch_no AS batchNo, l.material_name AS materialName, l.material_code AS materialCode, l.material_spec AS materialSpec, l.collect_quantity AS collectQuantity, l.unit_id AS unitId, l.collect_reason AS collectReason, l.collector_id AS collectorId, l.collect_time AS collectTime FROM lm_sample_collection_ledger l WHERE 1=1
AND l.material_id IN
#{materialId}
AND l.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
AND l.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND l.collect_time >= CONCAT(#{collectStartDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND l.collect_time <= CONCAT(#{collectEndDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY l.collect_time DESC
